title: Proportional Fairness for Harmful Decisions
summary:
We study allocation of (divisible) public bads, where agents incur costs for alternatives and the goal is to pick a lottery over the alternatives. We show that the traditional definitions of the core, a central criterion of proportional representation for allocation of public goods, private goods, and private bads (chores), do not make sense for allocation of public bads.
  We introduce two formalizations of the core tailored to public bads. Under a structural condition which subsumes allocation of private bads, we show that zero-respecting Lindahl equilibria satisfy both formalizations, exhibit additional fairness guarantees, and strictly generalize competitive equilibria from equal incomes (CEEI) for allocation of private bads. Without this structural condition, we show that Lindahl equilibria exhibit undesirable behaviors, prove sharp impossibility results separating public bads from public goods, but show that a rule using a reduction to public goods recovers one of our formalizations of the core. Our results lay the groundwork for studying fair allocation of public bads, an overlooked yet fundamental problem, and highlight several structural and algorithmic directions that remain open.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种专为可分割公共坏品分配设计的核心形式化定义，并分析了Lindahl均衡在特定条件下的公平性与局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统的核心定义无法直接应用于公共坏品分配，而该领域的公平分配问题长期被忽视，亟需建立理论基础。
AI.method: 提出两种针对公共坏品的核心形式化方法，并在特定结构条件下利用零尊重Lindahl均衡及向公共物品的归约策略进行分析。
AI.result: 在特定结构条件下，零尊重Lindahl均衡满足新核心定义并严格推广了CEEI；无此条件时，证明了分离公共坏品与公共物品的不可能性结果，但归约方法可恢复部分核心属性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为公共坏品公平分配奠定了理论基础，并指出了未来在结构与算法方向上的开放性研究问题。

title: VetClaw: An Edge-Cloud Multimodal Agentic System for Veterinary Disease Screening
summary: We present VetClaw, an edge-cloud multimodal agentic system for early veterinary disease screening. VetClaw uses a camera module as an edge sensing device and sends captured images, together with optional symptom descriptions, to a server-hosted vision-language model for zero-shot disease classification. The system separates agent interaction from workflow orchestration: OpenClaw provides scheduling, tool access, user interaction, and notification services on the edge device, while LangGraph manages the stateful screening workflow, including input validation, image transmission, model invocation, safety checks, conditional routing, failure handling, and structured logging. This design moves beyond static image classification by enabling the system to collect visual evidence, invoke external models, apply deterministic safety rules, and generate diagnostic-support alerts. Results show that image-only VLM prediction remains limited, whereas symptom-guided and multimodal inputs improve zero-shot classification performance. Thus, VetClaw transforms a static prediction model into a coordinated, safety-aware system that can use tools, manage workflows, handle failures, and escalate uncertain cases.

AI.tldr: VetClaw是一个用于兽医早期疾病筛查的端云多模态智能体系统，通过结合边缘端交互与云端工作流编排，实现了安全感知的零样本疾病分类。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决传统静态图像分类在兽医疾病筛查中预测能力受限、缺乏工作流管理、安全检查及故障处理机制的问题。
AI.method: 提出一种将智能体交互与工作流编排分离的架构：边缘端使用OpenClaw进行调度和用户交互，云端利用LangGraph管理有状态筛查工作流，并调用视觉语言模型（VLM）进行零样本疾病分类。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅依赖图像的VLM预测效果有限，而症状引导和多模态输入能有效提升零样本分类性能。
AI.conclusion: VetClaw成功将静态预测模型转化为协调、具备安全意识的系统，能调用工具、管理工作流、处理故障并升级不确定病例。

title: Desktop-Delta Bench: Do Computer-Use Models Understand Desktop GUI Transitions?
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly act through desktop GUIs to complete long-horizon tasks. Current benchmarks primarily measure end-task success or single-frame grounding. Neither isolates whether a model can reconstruct the causal, task-relevant transition produced by an action- crucial for rejecting stale observations, verifying progress, and recovering from failure. This is difficult because inference, remote input, app rendering, and screenshot capture are asynchronous: the next observation may be delayed, occluded, transient, or unrelated, then misread as progress and carried into subsequent planning. We introduce Desktop-Delta Bench (DDB), an offline step-level benchmark with 2,013 human-verified instances from novel, multi-app Linux trajectories across ~15 applications and 50 task domains. DDB trajectories targets 3 failure dimensions- state verification, source tracking, and context-aware control- through 2 complementary tasks: 463 3-frame temporal-ordering instances, including 105 with a cross-trajectory decoy, and 1,550 before-after pairs labeled from 5 actions + its payload. We evaluate 8 closed and open-source model families across 32 ordering and 16 single-action settings, observing consistent gaps. Ordering remains unsaturated: best non-decoy and decoy exact-match rates are 65.1% and 65.7%. Task context improves decoy identification by 6.9 percentage points but reduces non-decoy exact match by 2.2 points; error analysis reveals systematic copying of the presented A-B-C order. Single-action results show that inferring the action family is harder than locating it: click F1 is 0.96 vs, 0.76 for drag, while recognized drags are generally localized well. DDB, thus, complements end-to-end benchmarks by filling the missing diagnostic layer between GUI grounding and final task success, enabling targeted improvements to desktop CUA verification, reliability, and recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Desktop-Delta Bench (DDB)，一个步骤级诊断基准，用于评估计算机使用代理在异步桌面环境中重建动作因果转换的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有CUA基准只测量最终任务成功或单帧grounding，无法隔离测试模型能否重建动作产生的因果性、任务相关转换。这在异步环境中尤为关键，因为延迟、遮挡、瞬态或不相关的观察可能被误读为进展并带入后续规划，导致错误累积和恢复失败。
AI.method: 构建包含2,013个人工验证实例的离线步骤级基准，来源于~15个应用和50个任务域的多应用Linux轨迹。设计两个互补任务：463个3帧时序排列实例（含105个跨轨迹诱饵），以及1,550个前后对比对（标注自5类动作及其负载）。针对三个失败维度：状态验证、来源追踪和上下文感知控制进行评估。
AI.result: 评估8个模型家族后发现持续性能差距。时序排列任务未饱和：非诱饵和诱饵精确匹配率最佳仅65.1%和65.7%。任务上下文使诱饵识别提升6.9个百分点，但非诱饵精确匹配下降2.2个百分点；错误分析显示模型系统性地复制给定的A-B-C顺序。单动作任务中，推断动作类型比定位更难：点击F1为0.96，拖拽仅0.76。
AI.conclusion: DDB填补了GUI grounding与最终任务成功之间缺失的诊断层，补充了端到端基准，使研究者能针对性地改进桌面CUA的验证能力、可靠性和故障恢复。

title: UniMem: Complementary Episodic-to-Parametric Memory for Boundary-Agnostic Task Streams
summary: Memory is essential for LLM agents to accumulate task experience and reuse task-specific execution strategies. However, real-world deployment over boundary-agnostic and evolving task streams exposes a fundamental stability-plasticity dilemma. External retrieval-based memory can rapidly absorb new evidence, but it often fails to internalize recurring execution patterns and incurs inference-time retrieval overhead. Parametric memory enables stable and efficient execution once learned, but typically relies on explicit task boundaries and fixed parameter budgets. Inspired by the human brain, which balances plasticity and stability through complementary episodic storage and gradual consolidation, we propose UniMem, a self-routing framework for autonomous memory management. UniMem uses learnable routing tokens as memory controllers, enabling adaptive coordination between complementary memory pathways: novel or sparse tasks are retained in an episodic buffer for retrieval-augmented execution, while recurring and reliable patterns are consolidated into expandable parametric memory. By decoupling task identification from task execution with routing tokens and parametric memory blocks, UniMem expands memory on demand without task labels during deployment or uncontrolled parameter growth. Experiments on long-horizon streaming task sequences show that UniMem consistently outperforms baselines while maintaining execution fidelity, achieving an average gain of 4.0 EM points across three backbone models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniMem自路由框架，通过结合情景缓冲区和可扩展参数记忆，有效解决LLM智能体在流式任务中的稳定性-可塑性困境。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在无边界且不断演化的任务流中面临稳定性-可塑性困境：外部检索记忆难以内化模式且具有推理开销，而参数记忆依赖任务边界且参数预算固定。
AI.method: 提出UniMem框架，利用可学习的路由令牌作为记忆控制器，将新颖或稀疏任务路由至情景缓冲区进行检索，将重复可靠的模式整合至可扩展的参数记忆中，无需任务标签即可按需扩展记忆。
AI.result: 在长视界流式任务序列上的实验表明，UniMem在保持执行保真度的同时始终优于基线方法，在三个骨干模型上平均提升了4.0个EM点。
AI.conclusion: UniMem通过互补的记忆路径和自主记忆管理，成功平衡了可塑性与稳定性，实现了LLM智能体在无标签部署环境下的高效记忆扩展与模式内化。

title: Pictura: Perspective-View Self-Play at Scale for Driving
summary: Self-play in simulation produces robust driving policies at scale. Demonstrations of such behavior have been made using privileged vectorized observations such as exact poses and velocities, even for occluded agents. This assumes that perception is solved and introduces a representation gap with the partial observation of a deployed agent driving from the perspective view of egocentric cameras. A common fix, distilling the privileged policy into a camera-input student, leaves the student imitating decisions its own view cannot justify. Instead, we establish perspective-view self-play as a practical training regime. We introduce Pictura, a GPU-accelerated multi-agent driving simulator that renders each agent's egocentric view at every step, mitigating the representation gap at its source. Pictura sustains up to 500K agent-steps/s (2M images/s) on a single H100. Using Pictura, we train Alberti by self-play with plain PPO. It is the first large-scale driving self-play policy trained directly from perspective images, without privileged observations. Training spans 50B agent steps for ~35M km of driving. It approaches the driving performance of its privileged vectorized counterpart, and transfers zero-shot to Waymo Open Motion Dataset layouts re-rendered in Pictura, where it outperforms privileged vectorized agents. Project page: https://valeoai.github.io/Pictura/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个GPU加速的多智能体驾驶模拟器Pictura，并通过纯视角图像的自博弈训练了首个大规模驾驶策略Alberti。
AI.motivation: 现有自博弈驾驶策略通常使用特权的矢量化观察，这假设感知问题已解决，并在部署时与第一视角相机的部分观察产生表示鸿沟；而将其蒸馏为相机输入模型会导致模型模仿其自身视角无法证明的决策。
AI.method: 提出Pictura模拟器，在每一步渲染每个智能体的第一视角图像以从源头消除表示鸿沟，并使用PPO算法直接基于透视图进行自博弈训练得到Alberti策略。
AI.result: Pictura在单张H100上可维持50万步/秒的吞吐量；Alberti经过500亿步（约3500万公里）训练后，其驾驶性能接近特权矢量化策略，且在Waymo开放运动数据集上零样本迁移时优于特权矢量化智能体。
AI.conclusion: 第一视角自博弈是一种实用的训练机制，直接基于透视图进行大规模自博弈训练能够产生鲁棒的驾驶策略，有效消除特权信息带来的表示鸿沟。

title: MemLens: A Value-Aware Memory Management System with Interactive Analytics for LLM-based Agents
summary: Recently, memory management has become a key infrastructure for LLM-based agents, as it directly affects long-horizon reasoning, personalized responses, and knowledge reuse. However, existing LLM memory systems typically adopt a coarse-grained (utility-agnostic) manner that treats heterogeneous user-LLM interaction records uniformly, leading to redundant and low-impact records persisting in the memory repository. To address this challenge, we present MemLens, a value-aware memory management system that takes memory records as first-class data objects. MemLens provides an end-to-end interactive analytics dashboard that exposes the complete memory lifecycle, including Shapley-style memory evaluation, value-aware storage, and memory-assisted response. Through a study-copilot application, the system enables users to inspect memory values, visualize hierarchical memory structures, and compare various memory management strategies in terms of response quality, retrieval latency, and token consumption. Therefore, our MemLens can serve as an efficient, interpretable, and personalized long-term memory management system for LLM-based agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MemLens，一个价值感知的内存管理系统，通过端到端交互式分析仪表盘解决LLM智能体中异构交互记录粗粒度处理导致冗余的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM内存系统通常以效用不可知的粗粒度方式统一处理异构交互记录，导致内存库中存在大量冗余且低影响的记录。
AI.method: 提出MemLens系统，将内存记录作为一等数据对象，并提供端到端交互式分析仪表盘，展示完整的内存生命周期，包括Shapley风格的内存评估、价值感知存储和内存辅助响应。
AI.result: 通过学习辅助应用，系统使用户能够检查内存价值、可视化分层内存结构，并比较不同策略在响应质量、检索延迟和token消耗上的表现。
AI.conclusion: MemLens能够作为LLM智能体的高效、可解释且个性化的长期内存管理系统。

title: Who is scientific code for? Maintaining human-readable landmarks in agent-written code
summary: Scientific research involving code has long rested on the assumption that at least one person understands why the code exists. As scientists adopt coding agents, this assumption is breaking down. Drawing on an ongoing contextual inquiry of scientific programmers working with agentic tools (four cases to date), a survey of over 800 scientific programmers, and my own analysis workflows, this position piece describes how scientists are inventing personal conventions, "landmarking strategies", for marking which artifacts in a codebase are meant for human understanding and which are context for agents. They repurpose shared infrastructure (version control especially) in idiosyncratic ways, and I argue that this quiet de-standardization could complicate collaboration in teams with heterogeneous software practices. Alternatively, teams that explicitly delineate what is human-readable versus agent context will be better able to develop, document, and maintain scientific code.
comment: Position piece submitted to Infrastructure @ CSCW 26 workshop

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了科学家在使用编程代理时如何制定个人惯例以区分人类可读代码与代理上下文，并指出这种行为可能影响团队协作。
AI.motivation: 科学研究中编程代理的广泛使用打破了“至少有一人理解代码存在原因”的假设，引发了代码理解与团队协作上的潜在挑战。
AI.method: 基于对使用智能体工具的科研程序员进行的情境调查（四个案例）、对800多名科研程序员的问卷调查以及作者自身的工作流分析。
AI.result: 科研人员发明了“地标策略”来标记代码库中供人类理解的工件与供代理参考的上下文，并以个性化方式重新利用版本控制等共享基础设施，导致了隐性的去标准化现象。
AI.conclusion: 明确界定人类可读内容与代理上下文的团队能够更好地开发、记录和维护科学代码，从而缓解因软件实践异构化带来的协作复杂化问题。

title: Evaluating VLMs for Autonomous Agent-Driven Geometry Clipping Detection in Video Game QA
summary:
In this work, we study the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for anomaly detection in an agent-driven game Quality Assurance (QA) pipeline focusing on geometry clipping. In this evaluation, a custom exploration agent navigates a game level to collect visual observations, while the automatic annotation pipeline provides frame-level clipping labels. This setup allows us to evaluate recent VLMs on a controlled anomaly detection task without manual annotation. We benchmark six recent VLMs (Gemini, GPT, Qwen, Gemma, Llama, and Ministral) under a zero-shot prompting setting and analyse their sensitivity to four prompt variants.
  Our results show that while the VLMs can capture visual cues associated with geometry clipping, they all produce substantial false positives on visually ambiguous frames such as near-contact geometry and partial occlusions. Gemini-3.1-Flash achieves the best overall accuracy and is the most robust to prompt variation, while open-source models exhibit large precision--recall swings depending on the prompt design. These findings suggest that current VLMs are best suited as high-recall candidate filters within multi-stage QA pipelines rather than as standalone bug detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉语言模型（VLMs）在代理驱动的游戏质量保证（QA）流程中进行几何裁剪异常检测的应用。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决无需人工标注的游戏几何裁剪异常检测问题，并评估当前VLMs在该受控任务上的零样本检测能力。
AI.method: 使用自定义探索代理收集游戏关卡视觉观察，通过自动标注流程提供帧级标签，并在零样本提示设置下使用四种提示变体对六种VLMs进行基准测试。
AI.result: 结果表明，VLMs能捕获几何裁剪的视觉线索，但在视觉模糊帧上产生大量误报。Gemini-3.1-Flash准确率最高且对提示变化最稳健，而开源模型在不同提示下精确率-召回率波动较大。
AI.conclusion: 当前的VLMs更适合作为多阶段QA流程中的高召回率候选过滤器，而非独立的缺陷检测器。

title: Toward Standardized Cross-Vendor Agent Tool Trust Management in Autonomous Networks
summary: Autonomous Network Levels 4-5 require AI agents to invoke tools across vendor boundaries without human oversight, yet existing management standards lack a standardized mechanism for cross-vendor trust visibility. When a tool from Vendor B is compromised, agents from Vendor A continue invoking it -- unaware of the trust degradation -- causing cascading service impact. We present AgentToolMO, a proposed 3GPP NRM information model for agent tool trust management. The model comprises: a formally defined trust state machine with provable graduated enforcement, damped cascade propagation with bounded convergence, cross-vendor trust notifications via existing Management Services (MnS) interfaces, and retroactive impact assessment through NRM dependency graph traversal. Simulation-based evaluation across multi-vendor topologies shows that standardized cross-vendor notifications reduce blast radius from hours-scale undetected propagation to near-real-time containment bounded by MnS notification delivery, with cascade convergence guaranteed in bounded iterations and sub-linear notification scaling across vendor domains. The framework operates within existing 3GPP management infrastructure, leverages existing protocols, and provides a standardization pathway for trustworthy multi-vendor autonomous network management.

AI.tldr: 提出了3GPP NRM信息模型AgentToolMO，用于代理工具信任管理，以实现跨供应商的信任可见性和级联遏制。
AI.motivation: 自治网络级别4-5中AI代理跨供应商调用工具时缺乏标准化信任可见性机制，导致受损工具被无感知持续调用并引发级联服务影响。
AI.method: 提出AgentToolMO信息模型，包含具有可证明渐进执行的信任状态机、有界收敛的阻尼级联传播、基于现有MnS接口的跨供应商信任通知，以及基于NRM依赖图遍历的追溯影响评估。
AI.result: 仿真评估表明，该模型将故障爆炸半径从小时级未检测传播降至受MnS通知交付限制的近实时遏制，保证级联收敛在有界迭代内，且跨供应商域通知呈次线性扩展。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在现有3GPP管理基础设施和协议内运行，为可信赖的多供应商自治网络管理提供了标准化路径。

title: Interactive Reward Agent: GUI Task Evaluation via Environment-State Verification
summary: Graphical user interface task evaluation aims to determine whether a GUI agent has successfully completed a user instruction. Automated GUI task evaluation has received increasing attention because the evaluation results can serve as reward signals for both test-time scaling and post-training. However, reliable GUI task evaluation remains challenging because the judgments often require access to environment states, such as system configurations, file data, and application settings, beyond the screenshots of execution trajectories. In this paper, we propose an interactive reward agent (IRA) based on a propose-then-verify framework to acquire and verify evidence from the post-execution environment. Given a task instruction and a GUI environment after the GUI agent execution, IRA first proposes the task completion conditions and then verifies them by invoking system tools, application tools, and GUI tools. This design combines evidence from both visible interfaces and the environment state in an interactive process. We further introduce GUI-RewardBench, a benchmark of 321 GUI task trajectories spanning 10 Ubuntu desktop application categories. Experiments show that IRA achieves 86.9% accuracy on GUI-RewardBench, outperforming existing evaluator baselines. We further apply IRA to reinforcement learning of GUI agents, achieving a 34.0% OSWorld success rate, which demonstrates that IRA can provide effective reward signals for training GUI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于“先提议后验证”框架的交互式奖励智能体（IRA），通过结合可见界面和底层环境状态证据来可靠评估GUI任务，有效提升了GUI智能体强化学习的性能。
AI.motivation: 自动化GUI任务评估可为测试时扩展和后训练提供奖励信号，但由于任务成功的判断往往需要获取截图之外的底层环境状态（如系统配置、文件数据等），实现可靠的评估仍面临挑战。
AI.method: 提出交互式奖励智能体（IRA），采用“先提议后验证”框架。IRA首先提议任务完成条件，随后通过调用系统工具、应用工具和GUI工具在执行后的环境中验证这些条件，从而结合界面和环境状态证据。
AI.result: 在新引入的GUI-RewardBench基准上达到86.9%的准确率，优于现有基线；将其作为奖励信号应用于强化学习后，在OSWorld上实现了34.0%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 结合环境状态的交互式验证机制能有效评估GUI任务，且IRA能为训练GUI智能体提供有效的奖励信号。

title: FlowBlock: Wavefront-Parallel Decoding for Self-Correcting Diffusion Language Models
summary: Block-wise diffusion large language models (dLLMs) decode sequentially at the block level, enabling effective KV-cache reuse across blocks but making inter-block decoding strictly serial. Prior work has attempted to unlock inter-block parallelism through post-training methods, but achieves only modest speedups and often degrades accuracy. We observe that self-correcting dLLMs offer a training-free alternative: token-to-token (T2T) editing can repair tokens drafted with a slightly stale upstream context, so a downstream block requires only an informative draft rather than a finalized predecessor. This turns block finality from a hard dependency into a scheduling resource. We propose \textbf{\flowblock{}}, a training-free parallel decoding framework built on two mechanisms. (i) \emph{Gated Wavefront Decoding} admits blocks into a bounded wavefront only when a readiness gate is satisfied, jointly refines active blocks via T2T editing, and commits blocks in order under a windowed block-causal mask that preserves exact frozen-prefix KV caches reuse. (ii) \emph{Heterogeneous Wavefront Packing} assigns each request an independent wavefront while packing asynchronous windows into dense, shape-stable batched forwards. Across different benchmarks, \flowblock{} improves tokens per second (TPS) over LLaDA-2.1 and LLaDA-2.0, two serial block-wise dLLMs, by up to 2.95$\times$ and 4.01$\times$, while reducing latency by up to 53.6\% and 77.1\%, respectively. It also improves average accuracy by 1.3 points. Compared with D2F, a training-based inter-block-parallel baseline, \flowblock{} achieves higher accuracy and up to 16$\times$ higher batched serving throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的并行解码框架FlowBlock，通过门控波前解码和异构波前打包机制解决块级扩散大语言模型的串行解码问题，显著提升推理速度与吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 块级扩散大语言模型的块间解码严格串行限制了速度，而现有的后训练并行方法提速有限且损害准确性，因此需要一种不损失准确性的高效免训练并行解码方案。
AI.method: 提出基于自纠正机制的免训练框架FlowBlock，包含门控波前解码（通过就绪门和T2T编辑协同细化并按序提交块，同时保留冻结前缀KV缓存）与异构波前打包（将异步窗口打包成密集稳定的批量前向传播）两个机制。
AI.result: 相比LLaDA-2.1和LLaDA-2.0，每秒token数分别提升2.95倍和4.01倍，延迟降低53.6%和77.1%，平均准确率提升1.3分；相比基于训练的基线D2F，准确率更高且批处理吞吐量提升达16倍。
AI.conclusion: 利用自纠正dLLM的T2T编辑能力将块最终性从硬依赖转化为调度资源，可以实现高效且不降低准确性的免训练块间并行解码。

title: Trace-Based On-Policy Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are a promising alternative to autoregressive generation. However, reasoning-oriented post-training for dLLMs remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for dLLMs requires dense but often off-policy masked states, while reinforcement learning (RL) relies on sparse rewards or value modeling. This paper proposes \textbf{trace-based on-policy distillation (TOPD)}, a teacher-supervised framework that transfers reasoning ability to a target dLLM without reward estimation. The key idea is to supervise a dLLM on its own denoising trajectory, focusing on the trace-aligned token decisions that form the final response. Specifically, TOPD samples on-policy diffusion trajectories from the target dLLM, obtains teacher token distributions from a teacher model on the corresponding partially denoised states, and updates the target dLLM with a token-level Reverse Kullback-Leibler (Reverse-KL) objective. This design preserves dense teacher supervision while aligning training with the model's own denoising states. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, TOPD enables SDAR-4B-Chat to match the MATH500 accuracy of its RL-trained counterpart TraDo-4B-Instruct, with gains of +5.7 under static evaluation and +4.5 under dynamic evaluation. Compared with the RL-trained counterpart, TOPD achieves this with 4$\times$ fewer rollout rounds, corresponding to an estimated 96.0$\times$ to-accuracy model-compute speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于轨迹的在线策略蒸馏框架TOPD，通过教师模型对扩散语言模型自身去噪轨迹进行密集监督，在无需奖励估计的情况下高效提升其推理能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型的面向推理的后训练面临挑战：监督微调需要密集但常为离策略的掩码状态，强化学习则依赖稀疏奖励或价值建模。本文旨在解决dLLM推理后训练中监督信号密度与在线策略性难以兼顾的问题。
AI.method: 提出基于轨迹的在线策略蒸馏（TOPD）：从目标dLLM采样在线扩散轨迹，在对应的部分去噪状态上获取教师模型的token分布，以token级反向KL散度为目标更新目标dLLM，从而在模型自身去噪状态上进行密集教师监督。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上，TOPD使SDAR-4B-Chat在MATH500上匹配了RL训练对应模型TraDo-4B-Instruct的精度，静态评估提升+5.7，动态评估提升+4.5；相比RL方法仅需1/4的rollout轮次，估计实现约96.0倍的精度-计算加速比。
AI.conclusion: TOPD通过将密集教师监督与模型自身去噪轨迹对齐，在不使用奖励估计的情况下实现了高效推理能力迁移，显著降低计算开销，为扩散大语言模型的推理后训练提供了高效新范式。

title: LaCache: Exact Caching and Precision-Adaptive Inference for Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion-based Large Language Models(DLLMs) enable parallel generation via Semi-Autoregressive (SAR) decoding in text generation. However, current methods suffer from severe operator-level redundancy: they recompute the entire sequence during denoising steps, ignoring that the prefix and masked suffix remain invariant within a block. We propose LaCache, a training-free acceleration framework that alleviates this redundancy through lossless caching and mixed precision. Specifically, LaCache employs Lossless State Memoization (LSM) by caching three types of intermediate results: (i) EmbedCache for embedding outputs, (ii) RoPECache for token-wise pre-attention states, and (iii) FACache for the online softmax statistics within FlashAttention. These caches allow the model to skip redundant computation on unchanged tokens without altering the output. To further alleviate memory-bandwidth bottlenecks, LaCache inegrates a per-group FP8 quantization strategy for FFN layers, tailored to step-dependent activation distributions across the diffusion process. Experiments demonstrate that LaCache alone achieves approximately 1.3X end-to-end speedup over vanilla DLLM. When combined with existing acceleration methods, LaCache reaches up to 40.2X end-to-end speedup while maintaining comparable task accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为LaCache的免训练加速框架，通过无损缓存和混合精度量化消除基于扩散的大型语言模型在去噪过程中的算子级冗余，实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 当前的DLLMs在半自回归解码的去噪步骤中会重新计算整个序列，忽略了块内不变的前缀和掩码后缀，导致严重的算子级冗余。本文旨在解决该冗余问题以加速生成过程。
AI.method: 提出LaCache框架，通过无损状态记忆化（LSM）缓存嵌入输出、预注意力状态和FlashAttention在线softmax统计这三类中间结果，跳过不变token的冗余计算；同时为FFN层引入逐组FP8量化策略以缓解内存带宽瓶颈。
AI.result: 单独使用LaCache实现了约1.3倍的端到端加速；与现有加速方法结合时，端到端加速最高达40.2倍，且任务准确率保持相当。
AI.conclusion: LaCache能有效无损地消除DLLMs的算子级冗余并突破内存带宽瓶颈，在保持准确率的同时大幅提升生成速度，并能与现有加速方法协同工作。

title: A Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning Framework for Fine-Tuning Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: We formulate reinforcement learning (RL) in continuous time with discrete state spaces and possibly arbitrary action spaces via a stochastic control approach, where the state dynamics are modeled as a controlled continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC). We consider policy optimization problems and derive the corresponding policy gradient methods, leading to continuous-time variants of proximal policy optimization (PPO) and group relative policy optimization (GRPO). As a primary application, we develop a complete continuous-time RL framework for fine-tuning score-based discrete diffusion models. The proposed framework enables reward-driven optimization without requiring differentiability on the reward signals. In contrast to the existing GRPO-based approaches that only rely on terminal rewards, our formulation allows intermediate reward or advantage signals to be incorporated throughout the denoising trajectory. Importantly, when specialized to masked diffusion models (MDMs), our framework encompasses a rich class of policy parameterizations over the vocabulary simplex with analytically tractable probability ratios, providing a unified perspective on exploration and policy optimization in MDMs. For masked diffusion large language models (dLLMs), we further propose trajectory subsampling techniques to efficiently estimate computationally prohibitive trajectory likelihoods, reducing the computational cost of computing per-position probability ratios. We showcase the effectiveness of our methods on both low-dimensional entropy-regularized optimization problems and RL post-training of dLLMs on mathematical reasoning and coding tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个连续时间强化学习框架，用于微调离散扩散模型，并在掩码扩散语言模型上实现了高效的策略优化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于GRPO的方法仅依赖终端奖励，无法在去噪轨迹中间引入奖励信号；同时，扩散语言模型的轨迹似然计算成本高昂，亟需一个统一的连续时间RL框架来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 通过随机控制方法将连续时间RL建模为受控连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC），推导出连续时间版本的PPO和GRPO；针对掩码扩散模型提供了具有解析可处理概率比率的策略参数化；针对dLLM提出轨迹子采样技术以高效估计轨迹似然。
AI.result: 在低维熵正则化优化问题上验证了方法的有效性；在dLLM的数学推理和编程任务的强化学习后训练中展示了方法的有效性；所提框架允许在去噪轨迹全程引入中间奖励信号，且无需奖励信号可微。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为离散扩散模型的强化学习微调提供了统一视角，将探索与策略优化统一于掩码扩散模型中；轨迹子采样技术有效降低了计算成本，为dLLM的RL后训练提供了可行方案。

title: Accelerating Masked Diffusion Large Language Models: A Survey of Efficient Inference Techniques
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a theoretical advantage in parallel generation over standard autoregressive models. However, parallel generation alone does not guarantee practical speedups. Realizing this efficiency requires specialized inference mechanisms, such as diffusion-aware caching and reuse. Consequently, as inference efficiency becomes a prerequisite for practical deployment, recent research has actively explored acceleration techniques across algorithms, architectures, and systems. However, rigorous comparisons remain difficult, as end-to-end latency stems from intricate trade-offs between algorithmic, architectural, and system-level factors that are often conflated in existing benchmarks. In this survey, we introduce a unified latency decomposition framework for dLLMs to disentangle these factors and analyze their impact on inference speed in real deployments. Guided by this framework, we categorize acceleration techniques along three axes covering algorithmic innovations, architectural and system optimizations, and inference-time scaling. Finally, we provide guidelines for reproducible benchmarking and highlight open challenges for realizing the full potential of parallel generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一延迟分解框架，系统分析扩散大语言模型的推理加速技术并指导可复现基准测试。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型虽具备并行生成理论优势，但实际部署中端到端延迟受算法、架构和系统等多因素交错影响，现有基准难以严格比较，阻碍了推理效率优化和实际应用。
AI.method: 引入统一延迟分解框架，将影响推理速度的因素解耦，并沿三个维度对加速技术进行分类：算法创新、架构与系统优化、推理时扩展。
AI.result: 通过框架分析揭示了各层级因素对真实部署中推理速度的影响，提供了可复现基准测试的指导原则，并识别了实现并行生成全部潜力的开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 需在算法、架构和系统层面协同优化dLLM推理效率，建立标准化可复现基准测试方法，解决并行生成从理论优势到实际加速的转化难题。

title: BlockServe: Block-Grained Continuous Batching for High-Throughput Diffusion LLM Serving
summary: Efficient serving of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is hindered by convergence heterogeneity: when batching multiple requests, different sequences converge at different rates, causing faster requests to stall behind slower stragglers and introducing compute bubbles and tail latency. We present BlockServe, a continuous batching framework that integrates block-grained scheduling -- immediately evicting completed requests at block boundaries -- with mixed-state execution that extends dual cache and parallel decoding to heterogeneous batches via gather-scatter indexing. Furthermore, a compute-aware admission controller expands effective batch capacity through token-budgeted refill. On Dream and LLaDA across five benchmarks, BlockServe achieves 1.9--10.6$\times$ throughput over Fast-dLLM with comparable generation quality, establishing block-grained scheduling as a foundation for high-throughput offline dLLM inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BlockServe框架，通过块级调度和混合状态执行解决扩散大语言模型推理中的收敛异构性问题，显著提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 解决扩散大语言模型在批量处理请求时，因不同序列收敛速率不同（收敛异构性）导致的快速请求被慢速请求阻塞、产生计算气泡和尾延迟的问题。
AI.method: 提出连续批处理框架BlockServe，包含三个核心组件：在块边界立即驱逐已完成请求的块级调度；通过gather-scatter索引将双缓存和并行解码扩展至异构批次的混合状态执行；以及基于token预算补充以扩大有效批次容量的计算感知准入控制器。
AI.result: 在Dream和LLaDA模型的五个基准测试中，BlockServe的吞吐量比Fast-dLLM高出1.9至10.6倍，且生成质量相当。
AI.conclusion: 块级调度被证实可作为高吞吐量离线扩散大语言模型推理的基础架构。

title: Don't Commit Alone: Joint Token Commitment in Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) commit multiple tokens per denoising step by decoding each selected position independently from the shared context; when those positions are dependent, the resulting factorization error is captured by conditional total correlation, which confidence-based selection cannot observe from marginals alone. We propose CoCommit, a marker-gated coordination pass that briefly defers commitment: after the usual bundle selection, a learned marker announces the commit set and the backbone's last-$n$ layers are re-applied so marked positions coordinate -- approximating joint-mode decoding -- before greedy argmax writes tokens. The method reuses existing weights with one extra partial forward pass and no auxiliary model. On LLaDA2.1-mini with LoRA adapters and matched greedy inference, joint commitment improves accuracy on all six benchmarks we evaluate, with the largest gains on reasoning and exact-answer tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CoCommit方法，通过在扩散大语言模型中引入基于标记的协调步骤来近似联合模式解码，从而缓解多令牌独立提交时的分解误差。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型在去噪步骤中独立解码选定的多个令牌，当这些位置存在依赖关系时会产生分解误差（由条件总相关性捕获），而现有的基于置信度的选择方法无法仅从边缘分布中观察到此误差。
AI.method: 提出CoCommit——一种基于标记的协调过程。在常规束选择后，使用学习到的标记确定提交集，并重新应用骨干网络的最后n层使标记位置相互协调以近似联合模式解码，最后再进行贪婪写入。该方法仅复用现有权重并增加一次局部前向传播，无需辅助模型。
AI.result: 在LLaDA2.1-mini模型（使用LoRA适配器和匹配的贪婪推理）上的实验表明，联合提交在所有六个评估基准上均提高了准确率，其中在推理和精确问答任务上的提升最为显著。
AI.conclusion: CoCommit通过近似联合模式解码有效解决了扩散大语言模型中的多令牌分解误差问题，在不引入额外模型的情况下显著提升了性能，特别是在推理和精确回答任务上。

title: dOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising a masked sequence, offering a parallel alternative to autoregressive models, but eliciting strong reasoning through post-training remains difficult: supervised fine-tuning is off-policy and suffers from exposure bias, while reinforcement learning gives only sparse, sequence-level rewards and is hard to apply without tractable sequence likelihoods. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers a promising alternative, using one model as both student and teacher to provide dense, token-level, on-policy supervision, but its effectiveness hinges on giving the teacher privileged information (PI) - typically an instance-specific ground-truth reference unavailable at inference - so the student ends up distilling a weak PI-free consensus policy that yields little improvement on dLLM reasoning. We introduce dOPSD, which instead derives the teacher's privilege directly from the student's own denoising trajectory, evaluating masked positions using later, more-decoded steps of that same trajectory rather than an external label, so the teacher's advantage emerges from the model's own decoding process; on Dream and LLaDA, dOPSD improves both in-domain math reasoning and out-of-domain code generation, outperforming supervised and on-policy baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出dOPSD方法，通过利用模型自身的去噪轨迹作为特权信息进行在策略自蒸馏，有效提升了扩散大语言模型的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型在通过后训练激发推理能力时面临困难：监督微调存在策略外和暴露偏差问题，强化学习奖励稀疏且难以应用；现有的在策略自蒸馏依赖推理时不可用的外部特权信息（如真实标签），导致蒸馏效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出dOPSD方法，不依赖外部标签，而是直接从学生模型自身的去噪轨迹中提取教师模型的特权信息，利用同一轨迹中后续更充分的解码步骤来评估掩码位置，使优势从模型自身的解码过程中产生。
AI.result: 在Dream和LLaDA模型上的实验显示，dOPSD提升了领域内数学推理和领域外代码生成能力，优于监督和在策略基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过从模型自身的去噪轨迹中提取特权信息，dOPSD克服了传统在策略自蒸馏的局限性，为扩散大语言模型的后训练和推理能力提升提供了有效的新方案。

title: Sangam: Efficiently Serving Diffusion LLMs with the AR Stack
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising a masked response and can commit multiple output positions per model invocation. Their bidirectional attention prevents exact autoregressive-style KV caching, since committing one position shifts the KV activations of all others. Approximate caching techniques such as Fast-dLLM and dKV-Cache refresh KV activations repeatedly and reuse them across intervening decodes, inducing a repeated prefill/decode structure. This makes AR serving mechanisms relevant to dLLMs, but not directly applicable. dLLM decodes are block-sized rather than token-sized, prefills recur, and bidirectional attention precludes the chunked prefill mechanism used for stall-free colocated serving. We present Sangam, a serving system for cached dLLM inference. Sangam introduces a deficit token-budget scheduler that admits in-flight decodes first, admits whole indivisible prefills only when the accumulated token budget allows, and carries unused budget forward. This achieves amortized stall-free scheduling. Disaggregated serving avoids prefill-decode interference but suffers from prefill/decode resource partitioning problem. Sangam adopts a hybrid serving strategy, overflowing prefills onto decode workers to relieve prefill under-provisioning, and uses the same deficit-budget scheduler to protect those workers' decodes from the overflow. We show that like AR serving, dLLM serving design space is governed by prefill-decode interference and prefill/decode partitioning. Colocated serving is most effective on decode-heavy workloads, cutting mean latency by 9-20% over hybrid execution on LLaDA-8B ShareGPT; while hybrid execution is most effective on prefill-heavy workloads, cutting mean latency by 8-20% over colocated execution on Dream-7B arXiv. Sangam is available at https://github.com/UT-InfraAI/sangam.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sangam，一种针对扩散语言模型（dLLM）缓存推理的混合服务系统，通过赤字令牌预算调度器实现无停顿调度。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型的双向注意力和块状解码特性阻碍了传统自回归KV缓存和分块预填充机制的应用，近似缓存导致的重复预填充/解码结构使得现有服务机制无法直接使用，亟需针对缓存dLLM推理的专用服务系统。
AI.method: Sangam引入赤字令牌预算调度器（优先处理解码，按预算处理不可分割的预填充并结转余额）实现无停顿调度；并采用混合服务策略，将预填充溢出到解码节点缓解资源短缺，同时利用调度器保护解码过程免受干扰。
AI.result: 协同部署在解码密集型负载（LLaDA-8B ShareGPT）上比混合执行降低平均延迟9-20%；混合执行在预填充密集型负载（Dream-7B arXiv）上比协同部署降低平均延迟8-20%。
AI.conclusion: dLLM服务设计受预填充-解码干扰和资源划分影响，Sangam通过根据工作负载特征自适应选择协同部署或混合执行策略，有效优化了推理延迟。

title: DELTA-TTS: Adapting Autoregressive Model into Diffusion Language Model for Text-to-Speech
summary: Autoregressive (AR) text-to-speech (TTS) models generate discrete speech tokens sequentially, which makes inference slow and can degrade robustness by propagating local errors and hallucinations. This limitation stems from their left-to-right AR commitment: each token must be determined before future speech-token context is available. However, such ordering is not an inherent requirement for TTS, as the full input text is available before synthesis. In this paper, we introduce DELTA-TTS, a lightweight LoRA-based adaptation framework that converts a pretrained AR TTS model into a discrete diffusion language model (dLLM) for confidence-ordered speech-token decoding. To better capture the local structure of speech, DELTA-TTS incorporates a convolution module that injects local acoustic context, together with a $1/t$-weighted training objective and a time-shifted inference schedule that defer low-confidence positions to later steps. Trained on only $585$ hours of LibriTTS, DELTA-TTS achieves a $\textbf{1.75}\%$ WER on Seed-TTS test-en, outperforming its AR backbone while generating tokens $\textbf{3.3}\times$ faster. Further analysis shows that DELTA-TTS produces sharper text--speech alignment, increases overall decoding confidence, and mitigates hallucinations observed in AR generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DELTA-TTS，一种将预训练自回归TTS模型转化为离散扩散语言模型进行置信度有序解码的轻量级适配框架，以提高推理速度并减少错误传播和幻觉。
AI.motivation: 自回归TTS模型按顺序生成离散语音token导致推理缓慢，且通过传播局部错误和幻觉降低了鲁棒性。由于TTS在合成前已有完整文本输入，这种从左到右的自回归依赖并非必需。
AI.method: 采用基于LoRA的适配框架将预训练AR TTS模型转换为离散扩散语言模型(dLLM)进行置信度有序解码；引入卷积模块注入局部声学上下文，并结合1/t加权训练目标和时间偏移推理调度来推迟低置信度位置的生成。
AI.result: 在LibriTTS上仅训练585小时后，模型在Seed-TTS test-en上取得1.75%的WER，优于AR骨干网络且生成速度快3.3倍；分析表明其能产生更清晰的文本-语音对齐，提高解码置信度并减轻幻觉。
AI.conclusion: DELTA-TTS通过离散扩散模型实现置信度有序的语音token解码，有效解决了AR TTS推理慢和易产生幻觉的问题，实现了更快速、鲁棒的语音合成。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting several tokens and verifying them in parallel. Block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash produce a draft block in one pass but model only per-position marginals, and best-first tree methods such as DDTree expand candidate trees from those marginals. The released Domino drafter adds a GRU-based causal correction that makes each draft token distribution path-dependent, a structure DDTree's factorized formulation cannot represent. We introduce DominoTree, a training-free best-first draft tree scored by Domino's conditional, non-factorized correction along each root-to-node path, made practical by restricting the per-node correction to a candidate top-M set. On Qwen3-4B across eight benchmarks, DominoTree reaches up to 6.6x speedup over autoregressive decoding and the highest mean accepted length of any evaluated method, up to 10.7 tokens per round, at every tested temperature. DominoTree constructs its tree with a GPU-native CUDA-graph builder that is bit-identical to a reference Python implementation, so acceptance is unchanged, while keeping per-round tree construction cheap. With this builder as default, DominoTree improves throughput over the released Domino decoder, the drafter it builds on, at every tested temperature: 9% to 10% overall on Qwen3-4B and up to 22% on Alpaca. It also outperforms DDTree and CaDDTree at every tested temperature, not only under greedy decoding. On Qwen3-8B, DominoTree keeps the highest accepted length at every temperature and gives a 24% throughput gain over DDTree at T=0; at higher temperature its edge over DDTree and CaDDTree narrows to a tie and a small loss, while its aggregate gains over DFlash and Domino persist.

AI.tldr: 提出DominoTree，一种免训练的最佳优先草稿树方法，结合GPU原生构建器，通过利用路径依赖的条件修正显著提升了大模型投机解码的吞吐量和接受长度。
AI.motivation: 现有的最佳优先树方法（如DDTree）使用因式分解公式，无法表示像Domino这样具有路径依赖性的草稿器分布，从而限制了推理加速效果。
AI.method: 提出DominoTree，沿根到节点路径使用Domino的条件非因式分解修正进行评分，并通过限制候选top-M集确保实用性；同时采用位级相同且低成本的GPU原生CUDA-graph构建器来构造树。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B上实现高达6.6倍自回归加速，各温度下平均接受长度最高（达10.7 tokens/轮），吞吐量比Domino提升9-10%，优于DDTree和CaDDTree；在Qwen3-8B上接受长度最优，T=0时比DDTree吞吐量高24%。
AI.conclusion: DominoTree通过整合路径依赖草稿模型与高效GPU树构建器，在多种设置下显著提升了LLM推理效率，未来可探索在更高温度下的性能优化。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出CaDDTree方法，通过联合优化树结构和节点预算来最大化推测解码的吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的块扩散草稿树（如DDTree）在固定节点预算下最大化预期接受长度，盲目倾向于更大的树而忽略验证成本，缺乏选择预算的原则性基础。
AI.method: 提出CaDDTree，显式建模草稿和验证延迟，将吞吐量目标分解为对预算的逐轮一维搜索，并证明在凸验证成本下吞吐量函数是单峰的，从而实现高效的贪婪停止规则，无需离线预算搜索。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型及八个基准（涵盖推理、编程和指令遵循任务）上的实验表明，CaDDTree在几乎所有任务上均达到或超过了具有先知预算选择的DDTree。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree为推测解码中的预算选择提供了一种原则性的成本感知方法，无需离线调优即可动态适应，实现了更优的吞吐量。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 提出TAPS方法，通过目标感知的前缀选择解决投机解码中的验证瓶颈，实现高达7.9倍的无损加速。
AI.motivation: 使用扩散模型进行并行起草会将投机解码的瓶颈转移到验证阶段，而现有方法基于边际概率排序节点，忽略了前缀条件性，导致验证不可达节点并增加延迟。
AI.method: 提出TAPS（目标感知前缀选择）方法，将扩散边际概率转化为路径条件化的接受估计，并在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀闭合子树，以优化接受与成本的权衡。
AI.result: TAPS在多种数据集和模型上实现了高达7.9倍于原始自回归解码的无损端到端加速，比DFlash和DDTree分别快1.36倍和1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: TAPS有效解决了基于扩散的投机解码中的验证瓶颈，显著提升了验证效率和整体解码速度。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出DDTree方法，利用块扩散草稿模型的分布构建草稿树，以解决单轨迹验证的限制并提升推测解码性能。
AI.motivation: DFlash方法虽具领先性能，但每轮仅验证单一草拟轨迹，限制了推测解码的接受长度，本文旨在突破该瓶颈。
AI.method: DDTree利用块扩散草稿模型的逐位置分布构建草稿树，在固定节点预算下使用最佳优先堆算法选择最可能匹配的续写，并使用仅祖先注意力掩码在单次目标模型前向传播中完成验证。
AI.result: DDTree有效克服了单轨迹验证的局限，提升了接受长度，其性能增益使其跻身推测解码领域的领先方法之列。
AI.conclusion: 基于DFlash构建的DDTree通过树形结构验证机制显著提升了推测解码效率，确立了其在加速自回归语言模型中的领先地位。

title: Beyond Zooming: Learning Multi-Tool Visual Reasoning for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
summary: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote-sensing (RS) imagery provides fine-grained Earth-observation evidence over city-scale scenes, but poses a fundamental challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs): task-relevant evidence is often sparse, local, and spatially dispersed across extremely large visual contexts. A natural solution is to equip MLLMs with zoom-in tools for active local inspection. However, through a pilot study on XLRS-Bench, we find that zoom-in is only partially effective: it resolves easy and medium-level tasks with locally recoverable evidence, but saturates on hard cases requiring global search, multi-region comparison, path planning, or dispersed-evidence reasoning. Motivated by this finding, we move beyond single-tool zoom-in and introduce GeoMTVR, a large-scale Geospatial Multi-Tool Visual Reasoning dataset built from wide-area satellite imagery. GeoMTVR contains 13K UHR VQA samples with interleaved reasoning trajectories, diverse visual tool calls, and returned visual observations, enabling models to learn question decomposition, tool selection, regional inspection, object-level grounding, auxiliary visual reasoning, and cross-tool evidence integration. Beyond supervised fine-tuning, we propose a tool-attention-focused reinforcement learning algorithm that concentrates optimization on critical tool-use decisions, including when to invoke tools, which tool to select, where to apply it, and how to interpret tool outputs. By combining SFT on GeoMTVR with our RL algorithm, we develop GeoLens, a multi-tool visual reasoning MLLM for UHR RS. Experiments show that GeoLens consistently outperforms direct reasoning and single-tool zoom-in baselines, achieving stronger accuracy, better evidence grounding, and more efficient tool-use trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GeoMTVR数据集和GeoLens模型，通过多工具视觉推理和强化学习算法，提升多模态大语言模型在超高分辨率遥感图像上的任务表现。
AI.motivation: 解决超高分辨率遥感图像中任务相关证据稀疏且分散，而传统的单工具放大机制在全局搜索、多区域比较等复杂任务上效果不佳的问题。
AI.method: 构建了包含多工具视觉推理轨迹的GeoMTVR数据集进行有监督微调，并提出一种专注于工具注意力决策的强化学习算法，共同训练出GeoLens模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，GeoLens在准确率、证据定位和工具使用效率上均优于直接推理和单工具放大基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 多工具视觉推理结合强化学习能有效突破单工具放大在复杂超高分辨率遥感任务上的瓶颈，提升模型的推理和工具使用能力。

title: Evaluating Multi-Turn Multimodal Diagnostic Reasoning on Challenging Real-World Clinical Cases
summary: Clinical diagnostic evaluation should not only assess whether models can provide correct diagnoses, but also reflect the realities of clinical practice, including progressive disclosure of multimodal information, dynamic updating of diagnostic hypotheses, and continuous refinement of clinical reasoning. However, existing evaluations of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically rely on single-turn or isolated tasks, making it difficult to fully capture the complexity of real-world clinical diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we developed ClinMM-Bench, the largest multi-turn multimodal clinical diagnostic evaluation benchmark to date. ClinMM-Bench contains 1,089 challenging real-world clinical cases and 3,760 medical images across eight specialties. We systematically evaluated 15 representative MLLMs using a two-level evaluation framework that assessed both diagnostic accuracy and diagnostic reasoning quality. Results showed that proprietary models achieved the highest overall diagnostic accuracy, but the proportion of completely correct diagnoses remained limited across all models. In terms of diagnostic reasoning quality, current models can identify plausible diagnostic directions but still have considerable limitations in generating reliable diagnostic reasoning. Error analysis further identified five representative failure modes: information synthesis failure, knowledge mapping error, perception error, premature closure, and visual hallucination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClinMM-Bench多轮多模态临床诊断评估基准，揭示了当前多模态大模型在临床推理中的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有对多模态大语言模型的评估多依赖单轮或孤立任务，难以反映真实临床诊断中信息逐步披露和假设动态更新的复杂性。
AI.method: 构建包含1,089个真实病例和3,760张医学图像的ClinMM-Bench基准，采用两级评估框架对15个代表性模型的诊断准确率和推理质量进行系统评估。
AI.result: 专有模型诊断准确率最高但完全正确的比例有限；模型能找到合理诊断方向但推理可靠性不足；分析出信息合成失败、知识映射错误等五种代表性失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型在生成可靠临床诊断推理方面存在显著局限，需针对所发现的五种失败模式在未来进行重点改进。

title: RecoReward: Recommender-Guided Multimodal Description Generation for Recommendation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can convert multimodal item content into structured descriptions used as semantic features for recommendation. Conventional content-only generation, however, cannot use downstream user signals to determine which semantics should be emphasized. Recent user-conditioned methods incorporate these signals through user histories or profiles, but they require user information at inference and make generation user-dependent. In this paper, we introduce RecoReward, which instead uses behavior-derived rewards during training and preserves content-only inference. To instantiate this idea in live-stream recommendation, we treat historically engaged users as a proxy for future target users and use observational non-target users to estimate affinity shared broadly across users. The Recommender Affinity Score (RAS) contrasts these signals to provide user-selective feedback for reinforcement learning, allowing the learned policy to generate a single shared description without user inputs. In our offline benchmark, RecoReward-9B outperforms its Qwen3.5-9B baseline and all other evaluated models across seven recall metrics. Online A/B testing also shows performance gains. These results show that RecoReward trains the MLLM to produce item features that benefit downstream recommendation while retaining content-only serving.

AI.tldr: RecoReward通过在训练阶段使用行为衍生奖励进行强化学习，使多模态大语言模型在推理时仅需内容即可生成有利于推荐的特征描述。
AI.motivation: 现有的内容生成方法无法利用下游用户信号确定应强调的语义，而现有的用户条件方法在推理时需要用户信息，导致生成过程依赖于用户。
AI.method: 提出RecoReward方法，将历史互动用户作为未来目标用户的代理，利用非目标用户估计广泛共享的亲和力，并通过推荐亲和力得分（RAS）对比这些信号为强化学习提供用户选择性反馈，从而在无用户输入的情况下生成共享描述。
AI.result: 在离线基准测试中，RecoReward-9B在七项召回指标上均优于Qwen3.5-9B基线及其他评估模型，在线A/B测试也显示出性能提升。
AI.conclusion: RecoReward成功训练多模态大语言模型生成有益于下游推荐的项目特征，同时保留了仅基于内容的服务模式。

title: SepPrune:A Separator-based Pruning Framework for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3, generate large numbers of vision tokens for high-resolution inputs, leading to substantial computational cost. Existing vision token pruning methods either depend on cross-modal attention and cannot prune before the prefill stage, or rely on diversity estimation with high computational overhead. We observe that attention scores from both vision and text tokens peak at modality separator tokens, suggesting that these separators bridge the two modalities. Based on this observation, we propose SepPrune, an efficient, training-free, plug-and-play pruning method that uses the separator token as a unified query to rank and select informative vision tokens. SepPrune reuses the LLM's built-in projection parameters and requires no architectural changes. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B show that SepPrune achieves state-of-the-art performance, retaining 96.3% of the original accuracy while removing 80.2% of vision tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SepPrune的高效、免训练的即插即用视觉Token剪枝方法，利用模态分隔符Token作为统一查询来选择信息量大的视觉Token，从而降低多模态大语言模型的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率输入导致多模态大语言模型生成大量视觉Token，带来巨大的计算开销；而现有的剪枝方法要么无法在预填充阶段前进行剪枝，要么计算开销过高。
AI.method: 提出SepPrune方法，利用注意力分数在模态分隔符Token处达到峰值的观察，将分隔符Token作为统一查询来对视觉Token进行排名和选择，无需训练和架构更改，并复用LLM内置投影参数。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型上的实验表明，SepPrune在移除80.2%视觉Token的同时，保留了96.3%的原始准确率，达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: SepPrune为解决多模态大语言模型中视觉Token冗余问题提供了一种高效且无需额外训练的方案，在大幅降低计算成本的同时几乎不损失模型性能。

title: Sense it with your eyes: Sensation Generation and Understanding for Advertisements
summary: Sensory advertising evokes human senses through visual cues, enabling audiences to mentally simulate experiences and increasing persuasive impact. Despite the recent increase in using AI in generating and understanding creative and persuasive content, how advertisements visually evoke sensations remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce the first study of understanding, evaluating, and generating sensory ads. We introduce the Sensory Ad dataset, and define sensation classification tasks (SenseClass) to benchmark LLMs and MLLMs. We further propose SenseScore, an automated evaluation metric for sensation evocation achieving strong agreement with human judgments. Finally, we introduce the Sensory Ad Generation (SenseGen) task and propose SAGA, a multi-agent framework that improves message image alignment, sensory evocation, and persuasion. Our work establishes a foundation for sensory-aware visual persuasion.

AI.tldr: 本文首次研究了感官广告的理解、评估与生成，提出了相关数据集、评估指标和多智能体生成框架SAGA。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI在生成和理解创意说服内容方面的应用日益增加，但广告如何通过视觉唤起人类感官体验这一问题仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出了Sensory Ad数据集和SenseClass分类任务对模型进行基准测试，引入了SenseScore自动评估指标，并提出了多智能体框架SAGA来解决感官广告生成（SenseGen）任务。
AI.result: SenseScore指标与人类判断具有高度一致性，且SAGA框架有效提升了信息与图像的对齐度、感官唤起效果以及广告说服力。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为感官感知的视觉说服研究奠定了基础。

title: MEDit-Bench: A Dataset for Evaluating Message-Driven Narrative Video Editing
summary: Video editing is fundamentally message-driven: even from the same source footage, the selected shots change depending on the narrative the editor wishes to convey. Benchmarks for a closely related task, video summarization, reduce editorial intent to a single, message-agnostic notion of saliency and thus do not account for this diversity. For evaluating message-driven video editing, we present \textbf{MEDit-Bench}, a dataset and benchmark, which pairs long-form videos with multiple editing messages and multiple professionally produced edits per message, demonstrating that different messages yield substantially different edits from the same source. We define an automatic evaluation protocol based on temporal alignment metrics, and find that an LLM-as-a-judge preference, a natural proxy for narrative quality, is unreliable for this task due to severe position bias. We additionally annotate each message with ambiguity and contextfulness scores, and show that both dimensions negatively correlate with model performance, establishing message difficulty as a meaningful stratification factor. Experiments with state-of-the-art MLLMs and reinforcement fine-tuned baselines show that while strong models approach human temporal alignment at lenient thresholds, all models fall behind humans at stricter criteria. A human perceptual study further confirms a large quality gap, with professional human edits remaining consistently preferred over model outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MEDit-Bench基准测试，用于评估基于不同叙事消息的视频编辑任务，揭示了当前模型与人类专业编辑之间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频摘要基准测试忽略了编辑意图的多样性，采用与消息无关的显著性概念，无法有效评估基于特定叙事消息的视频编辑任务。
AI.method: 构建了包含长视频、多种编辑消息及专业编辑版本的MEDit-Bench数据集，提出基于时间对齐的自动评估协议，并引入歧义性和上下文丰富度作为消息难度标注。
AI.result: 实验发现LLM-as-a-judge存在严重位置偏差；消息难度与模型性能负相关；先进模型在宽松标准下接近人类时间对齐，但在严格标准和人类感知研究中仍远落后于专业编辑。
AI.conclusion: 消息难度是评估模型表现的重要分层因素，当前最先进的模型在消息驱动的视频编辑质量上仍无法匹敌人类专业编辑。

title: FORGE: Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry for Long-Form Video Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled long-form video understanding at a scale that was not previously possible. However, the density of relevant content decreases sharply as video sequence length increases, and exposing the model to more irrelevant content measurably reduces its accuracy. In this paper, we address the problem of maximizing query-relevant information in a frame subset selected at inference time, without training. FORGE (Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry) is a model-agnostic method that induces a query-conditioned geometry on a pretrained multimodal embedding space, unifying relevance and diversity into a single objective. In this space, frames that cover independent query-relevant directions are far apart, and selecting the subset of maximum information captures diverse query-relevant content within the budget. Experiments on Video-MME and LongVideoBench at budgets of 16, 32, and 64 frames show that FORGE improves the unified keyframe selection score by 11.0-15.3 points over the strongest training-free baseline and up to doubles keyframe recall (0.415 vs. 0.204 at K=64 on Video-MME). The gains extend to question answering, where accuracy improves in every evaluated setting across eight open-source MLLMs spanning 4B to 32B parameters, by up to 8.7 points over uniform sampling and 5.2 points over the strongest baseline. Our findings suggest that aligning the embedding space with the query's high-dimensional structure is a promising direction for inference-time video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的模型无关方法FORGE，通过在多模态嵌入空间中引入查询条件几何来统一相关性和多样性，从而最大化长视频理解中的查询相关信息。
AI.motivation: 随着视频序列长度增加，相关内容的密度急剧下降，暴露于无关内容会降低多模态大语言模型的准确率。本文旨在解决在推理时无需训练即可最大化所选帧子集中查询相关信息的问题。
AI.method: FORGE在预训练的多模态嵌入空间中引入查询条件几何，将相关性和多样性统一为单一目标，使覆盖独立查询相关方向的帧相距甚远，从而在预算内捕获最大信息的多样化查询相关内容。
AI.result: 在Video-MME和LongVideoBench上的实验表明，FORGE在16至64帧预算下，相比最强免训练基线将关键帧选择分数提升11.0-15.3分，召回率最高提升一倍；在8个开源模型上的问答准确率全面提升，最高比均匀采样提升8.7分，比最强基线提升5.2分。
AI.conclusion: 将嵌入空间与查询的高维结构对齐是推理时视频理解的一个有前景的研究方向。

title: Rethinking CD: A Reproducibility Study and Extension on the Ineffectiveness of Contrastive Decoding at Mitigating Object Hallucinations in MLLMs
summary: Contrastive decoding (CD) has been proposed as a training-free strategy for mitigating object hallucinations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), with reported gains on benchmarks such as POPE. However, recent work has questioned whether these gains reflect genuine improvements in visual grounding. In this study, we reproduce and extend the findings of "The Mirage of Performance Gains: Why Contrastive Decoding Fails to Mitigate Object Hallucinations in MLLMs." Specifically, we test the claim that CD induces a unidirectional output distribution shift in discriminative datasets and examine its generalizability across datasets. We also verify that the adaptive plausibility constraint (APC) reduces sampling to greedy search on both discriminative and generative benchmarks. Beyond reproduction, we rigorously study the effects of CD across generative and discriminative datasets. We conduct several experiments that provide additional insights: we analyze the logit distributions induced by different CD strategies on generative datasets, propose a proxy method and compare its performance against CD techniques, and investigate how hallucination signals propagate through each layer of the expert and amateur models. Experimental results across MME, POPE, and CHAIR using LLaVA and Qwen validate the original claims and show that the apparent improvements from CD are often spurious and do not consistently translate into stronger visual grounding for reducing hallucinations. These findings challenge the effectiveness of current contrastive decoding strategies and motivate the development of more reliable approaches for mitigating hallucinations in MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文重现并扩展了先前研究，证明对比解码在缓解多模态大语言模型物体幻觉上的表面改进是虚假的，并未真正增强视觉基础能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在验证对比解码（CD）是否真正改善了视觉基础还是仅改变了输出分布，并重现与扩展先前关于CD无法有效缓解MLLMs物体幻觉的结论。
AI.method: 通过分析不同CD策略诱导的logit分布，提出代理方法进行性能对比，验证自适应合理性约束（APC）的作用，并探究幻觉信号在专家与业余模型各层中的传播，实验涵盖LLaVA和Qwen及MME、POPE、CHAIR数据集。
AI.result: 实验验证了CD带来的性能提升是虚假的；APC将采样退化为贪婪搜索；CD引起的单向输出分布偏移并未转化为更强健的视觉基础以减少幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 当前对比解码策略在缓解MLLMs幻觉方面缺乏有效性，凸显了开发更可靠幻觉缓解方法的必要性。

title: LENS: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Zooming for Keyframe Sampling in Long-Form Videos
summary: Despite rapid progress in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), understanding long-form videos is still bottlenecked by limited context windows. While recent keyframe sampling methods attempt to mitigate this by distilling video inputs into a compact set of query-relevant frames, navigating the vast spatio-temporal search space remains challenging, as spatial detail and temporal coverage often conflict. To address this, we introduce LENS, a training-free keyframe sampling framework that dynamically decides when to zoom in for fine-grained details and when to zoom out for broader context based on the text query. Concretely, LENS adaptively allocates a limited frame budget between spatial zoom-ins, which highlight query-relevant regions within individual frames, and temporal zoom-outs, which expand the temporal scope through multi-frame aggregation, enabling the model to reason across multiple granularities while capturing both high-fidelity details and long-range context. Across diverse long-form video benchmarks, LENS consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art keyframe sampling methods and delivers substantial gains over uniform sampling, improving Video-MME accuracy from 53.3% to 60.7% with Qwen2.5-VL.Code is available at https://github.com/zhangce01/LENS.
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://zhangce01.github.io/LENS/

AI.tldr: 本文提出无需训练的关键帧采样框架LENS，通过动态分配空间放大与时间缩小以平衡细节与上下文，提升了多模态大语言模型的长视频理解性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型受限于上下文窗口难以理解长视频，且现有关键帧采样方法在空间细节与时间覆盖之间存在冲突。
AI.method: 提出LENS框架，基于文本查询动态分配帧预算，结合空间放大（聚焦帧内查询相关区域）与时间缩小（多帧聚合扩展时间范围）实现多粒度推理。
AI.result: 在多个长视频基准测试中，LENS优于现有SOTA方法，使用Qwen2.5-VL将Video-MME准确率从53.3%提升至60.7%。
AI.conclusion: LENS有效解决了长视频理解中细节与上下文的权衡问题，使模型能同时捕捉高保真细节与长程上下文。

title: Chart-Supported or Model-Supplied? Examining MLLM-Generated Claims for Accessible Visualization
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can connect visualization patterns to external causes, consequences, and domain knowledge, but the evidential basis of these interpretations is often unclear. We present an exploratory study of 102 visualizations from four sources, three MLLMs, and four input conditions that vary access to the image, source-specific accessible chart context, and withheld-context framing. Across 1,224 descriptions, we analyze model-attributed DIRECT, DERIVED, and SPECULATIVE labels and conduct an automated audit of numeric agreement. Accessible chart context shifted Gemini and GPT toward DIRECT claims and improved numeric agreement for some models. Adding the image to the full context did not yield a consistent numeric benefit, and the withheld-context prompt did not reliably increase cautious language. The prompt-defined Real-World Significance section remained predominantly SPECULATIVE. These results motivate accessible description systems that distinguish claims supported by supplied evidence from model-supplied interpretation
comment: Submitted to the 3rd Workshop on Accessible Data Visualization, IEEE VIS 2026

AI.tldr: 本文对多模态大语言模型在不同输入条件下对可视化图表解释的证据基础进行了探索性研究。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能将可视化模式与外部原因、结果及领域知识联系起来，但这些解释的证据基础通常不明确。
AI.method: 对来自四个数据源的102个可视化图表、三个MLLMs和四种输入条件进行探索性研究，分析了1224个描述中的直接(DIRECT)、推导(DERIVED)和推测(SPECULATIVE)标签，并进行数值一致性的自动审计。
AI.result: 可访问的图表上下文促使Gemini和GPT更多地做出直接声明，并提高了部分模型的数值一致性；在全上下文中添加图像未产生一致的数值收益；隐藏上下文提示未可靠增加谨慎用语；现实意义部分仍主要以推测为主。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果推动了无障碍描述系统的发展，以区分由提供证据支持的声明与模型自身提供的解释。
